video_title: 'I THINK IT'S OVER!' - Charles Barkley reacts to Knicks' halftime lead in Game 3 🗣️ | Inside the NBA

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley calls the foul on Jalen Brunson a turning point
quotes.excerpt: I said this is a turning point in the game. I said, Ernie, that's the turning point.

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Barkley
text_blocks.text: I said, uh-oh, this is a turning point in the game. I said, Ernie, that's the turning point. They had a four-point lead.

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Smith
text_blocks.text: There are two things about this play. Number one, you got the lead and the ball. There was no need for it.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Smith
text_blocks.text: What really pissed me off about the play, Ernie, and Dray, Shaq, and Kenny knows this: you have to know who you can intimidate on other teams. You are just going to piss Jalen Brunson off.

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Barkley
text_blocks.text: We know who is soft on other teams. You are not going to intimidate Mr. Brunson. You are just wasting fouls, giving them momentum.

quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith criticizes the Spurs for trying to intimidate Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: You have to know who you can intimidate on other teams. You are just going to piss Jalen Brunson off.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith praises Josh Hart as the Knicks' X-factor
quotes.excerpt: Today, Josh Hart is the X-factor and the catalyst.
quotes.quote: At the start of the game, I said this is a game where someone has to emerge and do something different other than Jalen Brunson or Victor Wembanyama. It was Josh Hart early, and he was really impressive. Today, Josh Hart is the X-factor and the catalyst.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses OG Anunoby's impact before his injury
quotes.excerpt: Before he went out with injury, he was one of the best players on their team.
quotes.quote: Before he went out with injury, he was one of the best players on their team. You look tonight, he is shooting the ball well, taking advantage of mismatches. He is the one guy who has a size advantage over just about anyone who is going to guard him outside of Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal praises Victor Wembanyama's energy and effort
quotes.excerpt: I love that he is playing with energy, enthusiasm, and effort.
quotes.quote: I love that he is playing with energy, enthusiasm, and effort. They got out to a great start, they didn't keep that lead, but listen, this is what you want to see if you are a big man.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley wants the Knicks to involve Karl-Anthony Towns more
quotes.excerpt: I wish that the Knicks would get the ball to Karl-Anthony Towns a little bit more.
quotes.quote: I wish that the Knicks would get the ball to Karl-Anthony Towns a little bit more. He scored pretty much every time he touched it, but listen man, I told you tonight, this series is a wrap.
